flows: Text, textarea, number, checkbox and choice fields restore together, including groups with a disabled first option
Canceled and disabled resets preserve invalid numeric drafts; accepted reset clears them; a newer draft keeps its accepted state
New text, supplied textarea state and same-value radio change survive a pending reset without blocking sibling fields
Pending field resets retire on replacement and disposal, and replacement defaults stay authoritative
Host Reset pointerdown and focus transfer defer error visibility until click; first dispatched click resets once, and pointercancel releases validation
boundary: Five independent JSDOM groups against the exact local browser global build. Pointer sequencing checks error visibility, not native geometry. No complete52 release, medical formula or service.
